newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Antarctica Piaui started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Antarctica Piaui started as buy.

text.p: -- Fator Securities said in a statement it started coverage of Industrias de Bebidas Antarctica Piaui S/A with a buy recommendation.
-- It said Antarctica Piaui has one of the highest operating margins within the Antarctica group and the brewing industry as a whole.

-- Fator's analyst Juliana Chu forecast a slight fall in Antarctica Piaui's gross margin to 51 percent in 1996 from 51.9 percent last year, and a rise in its net margin to 29 percent from 24.4 percent in 1995.

-- "Like other companies within the group, Antarctica Piaui has paid generous dividends, making it an attractive option for conservative investors despite the stock's low liquidity," the statement said.
-- Fator forecast net income to reach 35.9 million reais in 1996, 36.2 million in 1997 and 38.1 million in 1998 with dividend yield of 13.7 percent, 15.1 percent and 16.5 percent, respectively.
